script.speaker: student
script.text: Hi, I want to use the gym. Do I need a card?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes. The card costs eighty lira for one term.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Can I pay next week? I don't have money today.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: You can, but you cannot enter before you pay.

question.stem: What must the student do before using the gym?
question.explain_tr: Görevli ödeme yapılmadan girilemeyeceğini söylüyor. Ödemeyi haftaya bırakmak mümkün ama o zamana kadar giriş yok.
question.key_line: You can, but you cannot enter before you pay.
